intro: This Must Be The Place marks the site of a recently abandoned campsite whose occupant vanished just moments prior. A torn note left behind reveals that the mysterious author has taken their work underground to keep it out of the wrong hands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: "So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands."

The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Heavy canvas is rolled over assorted equipment. You help yourself to the pack.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
